issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

displayGroupingAlertLogicDescriptionTran.description:
Translation key of the string description of the Similarity Score calculation and the pre-calculation alert filtering logic.
The field will be referenced in the UI (e.g., in Similarity Score Grid tooltip).

automaticallyAddToCase.description: Indicates whether automatic addition to {@link ReliabilityAssetCase}s for {@link ReliabilityAssetAlert} should be enabled.

groupToCasesFetchSpec.description:
Once similar {@link ReliabilityAssetAlert}s are determined for a specific alert,
the next step is to retrieve {@link ReliabilityAssetCase}s associated with the similar alerts.
This {@link FetchSpec} along with a pre-determined filter will be used to retrieve the respective cases to automatically add the alert to.

The default is { filter: '', order: 'descending(latestActivityTime)', limit: 1 }

- `filter`: Should be set to retrieve the most recent case for the similar alert.
- `order`: Should be set to descending(latestActivityTime) to ensure the most recent case is retrieved.
- `limit`: Should be set to 1 to ensure only the most recent case is retrieved.

similarityTypeName.description:
Support for Postgres or Cassandra storage is determined by the scale of alerts triggered in the application.
This configuration field specifies the selected data type used to retrieve similarity data.

alertSimilarityFilterThreshold.description:
Threshold for filtering similar alerts and determining case assignments.

This value controls which similar alerts are retrieved in the UI for a specific alert. Similar alerts
with a similarity score greater than or equal to this threshold will be retrieved.

Additionally, when automatically adding an alert to case(s), the applicable cases are retrieved from the cases
of the similar alerts. This value will also filter the similar alerts to determine which cases to add the alert to.

similaritiesForAlertsInCaseFetchLimit.description:
The limit for the fetch call used to retrieve similarities for alerts belonging to a {@link ReliabilityAssetCase} in
{@link ReliabilityAssetCase#fetchSimilarAlerts}. The default value is set to default value 2000 but can be increased.
